business_problem: Symphony needed to modernize the storage and search stack behind its regulated collaboration platform so it could keep encrypted communications searchable for audits at billions-of-entry scale without running costly internal Elasticsearch clusters.
solution_summary: Symphony reworked the data platform behind its financial-services collaboration product by moving audit-trail storage and search from internally operated Elasticsearch clusters to MongoDB Atlas and MongoDB Atlas Search. The platform already handles encrypted messages, group chats, rich-content sharing, bot-driven workflows, and integrations such as WhatsApp, so the supporting database had to be resilient, automated, and compliant. Atlas became the managed store for critical customer data, while Atlas Search now powers the rich audit-trail interface customers use to retrieve historical records quickly. Symphony integrated Atlas with Terraform and its operational tooling so teams could provision repeatable environments faster, and tied Atlas into Datadog and Splunk for observability. The result is a simpler, container-friendly architecture on key cloud vendors that reduced operational burden while improving security, scale, and cost control.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores Symphony's regulated collaboration and audit-trail data in a fully managed database platform.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas Search
solution_components.role: Indexes audit-trail records so financial institutions can run fast, filtered compliance searches.

data_flow: Encrypted messages, group-chat activity, bot workflows, and audit-trail events are written into MongoDB Atlas. Atlas Search indexes that history for Symphony's audit UI so customers can retrieve records quickly, while Datadog and Splunk monitor the Atlas-backed environment and Terraform helps redeploy it consistently.
business_outcome: Symphony cut audit search latency from 30 seconds to about one second, simplified operations, lowered infrastructure footprint, and strengthened the compliance posture of its financial-services messaging platform.
